page.content:
Seafloor hot springs that support chemosynthetic communities.

How Hydrothermal vents connects

  • Location: Galápagos Rift — The first documented vent community was on the Galápagos Rift.
  • Vehicle: Black smokers — Black smokers are the sulfide chimneys of high-temperature vents.
  • Item: DSV Alvin — Alvin dived the Galápagos Rift when vents were first seen.
  • Character: Robert Ballard — Ballard was part of the early vent and ridge exploration from WHOI.

What is Hydrothermal vents?

Hydrothermal vents were documented at the Galápagos Rift in 1977: black smokers and tubeworms living on chemicals, not sunlight, rewriting the energy budget of the deep.

Key threads lead to Galápagos Rift, Black smokers, DSV Alvin and Robert Ballard.
